from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financing cash flow data extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the report")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written for financing cash flow")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash flow")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flow_records: list[CompanyCashFlowRecord]
